message.content: On June 26, 2026, LiHua and ChaeSong-hwa had a conversation centered around the successful completion of their research study and the upcoming celebration they planned to hold after their jam session. In this exchange, ChaeSong-hwa expressed his excitement about the breakthrough in their research and the progress they had made. He mentioned that they had gathered enough research data and were ready to test their model. LiHua responded with support and shared her enthusiasm, encouraging ChaeSong-hwa to celebrate their achievement. They discussed the details of the celebration, including the type of snacks and drinks they would bring, and the idea of making it a fun night together. This conversation highlights their collaborative effort, the importance of teamwork, and their mutual appreciation for each other's contributions to their shared goals.
